task_objective: Create and maintain a grocery list using actual needs and current stock to reduce missed items and duplicate buying.

scoring_rule.1: Identify what will be needed before shopping by reviewing upcoming use, recurring essentials, household requests or an equivalent needs check.

rius.rationale: A list not grounded in needs cannot address the stated problem of forgotten required items.

rius.description: Check what is already available before adding or buying items, so the list excludes unnecessary duplicates.

scoring_rule.1: Check what is already available before adding or buying items, so the list excludes unnecessary duplicates.

rius.rationale: Without a stock check the list can repeat purchases even if expected needs are correctly identified.

scoring_rule.1: Record the needed missing items in a list that can be consulted during shopping.

rius.rationale: Turns the needs and stock checks into the requested usable shopping aid without prescribing an app or format.

rius.description: Keep the list current when an item is used up or bought, for example by adding depleted supplies and marking off purchases.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Keep the list current when an item is used up or bought, for example by adding depleted supplies and marking off purchases.

rius.rationale: Maintains the list between shopping trips rather than duplicating the initial stock check.

task_objective: Plan a controlled migration between shared collaboration platforms that retains content, access, links, history and user readiness.
constraints: Keep a recoverable source or rollback path until the migrated platform has been verified. A non-destructive parallel copy that retains the intact source satisfies this without a separate backup instruction.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Inventory the source content and decide what is in migration scope before moving it.

rius.rationale: Defines the migration set without requiring every incidental platform object to be transferred.

rius.description: Transfer in-scope content and verify the destination against the source for loss or corruption before treating the destination as complete.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Transfer in-scope content and verify the destination against the source for loss or corruption before treating the destination as complete.

rius.rationale: Unchecked missing content defeats replacement of the shared platform even when permissions and training are adequate.

rius.description: Map source access permissions to intended destination users or groups and validate the resulting access rather than defaulting to unrestricted sharing.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Map source access permissions to intended destination users or groups and validate the resulting access rather than defaulting to unrestricted sharing.

rius.rationale: A migration that exposes restricted collaboration content creates a credible data-access risk.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Update or preserve references so links to migrated content resolve to the intended destination.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Retain needed historical versions or records in the destination or a retrievable archive rather than discarding them with the old platform.

rius.rationale: Losing needed history during replacement can irreversibly destroy records even when current documents survive.

scoring_rule.1: Prepare users to use the new platform through appropriate training or practical guidance before they must rely on it.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.

rius.description: Keep a recoverable source or rollback path until the migrated platform has been verified. A non-destructive parallel copy that retains the intact source satisfies this without a separate backup instruction.

task_objective: Design a simple household stock-tracking and replenishment cycle to reduce unexpected supply shortages.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Keep an accessible record or observable stock check of commonly used supplies and their current availability.

rius.rationale: Without knowing current stock the requested inventory component is missing.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Set a replenishment trigger before a supply is exhausted, using a minimum level, reserve item, expected use, lead time or an equivalent rule.

rius.rationale: Reordering only after depletion does not address the stated unexpected-runout problem.

rius.description: Connect the trigger to an actual restocking action, such as adding the item to a purchase list for the next suitable trip or assigning someone to obtain it in time.

rius.rationale: Tracking and thresholds alone cannot restore supplies without a way to act on them.
